current_inner_contract: requires exactly four capability families: EXPLORATION/F2-WP-802, MODELING/F2-WP-803, GOAL_SETTING/F2-WP-804, PLANNING_EXECUTION/F2-WP-805
CapabilityEvidence binds exact source claim/reconciliation/receipt hashes plus benchmark_id, holdout_set_id, baseline/intervention scores and sample/success/action counts
FalsifierPolicy can require one shared holdout_set_id across all four capability records

evaluator fails closed on missing/non-ACCEPTED sources, duplicate receipts/reconciliations, mixed holdout when shared holdout is required, insufficient samples, low intervention score or low delta over baseline
report exposes conservative minima across capability score and delta plus total sample/success/action counts
generalization_gap: one shared holdout_set_id can prove matched four-capability evaluation inside one held-out family, but cannot by itself establish cross-family generalization
current report has no task-family identity, task-generator identity, metamorphic-equivalence identity, variant-group identity or trial-group identity
current policy has no robustness bound for semantically equivalent surface perturbations and no cross-family floor
current action/sample/success aggregates do not distinguish benchmark-specific success from behavior that survives disjoint task families
repeating the identical deterministic repository component run would add no independent generalization evidence

external_primary_evidence.observed_claim: evaluates agents across eight distinct interactive environments and reports failure modes in long-term reasoning, decision-making and instruction following
external_primary_evidence.transfer_to_f2: cross-environment breadth is evidence that agent evaluation should not collapse onto one task surface; F2 should encode distinct task-family identities rather than infer generality from one shared holdout

external_primary_evidence.source: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants
external_primary_evidence.observed_claim: uses real-world questions requiring reasoning, multimodality, browsing and tool use, while withholding answers for 300 questions used by the leaderboard
external_primary_evidence.transfer_to_f2: evaluation targets/answers remain evaluator-side; candidate adaptation must be sealed before hidden evaluation artifacts are exposed

external_primary_evidence.source: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
external_primary_evidence.observed_claim: uses detailed initial-state setup and task-specific execution-based evaluators for reproducible end-state assessment
external_primary_evidence.transfer_to_f2: retain evaluator-owned setup/result authority and score externally observed state transitions/outcomes, not model narration or self-report

external_primary_evidence.source: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
external_primary_evidence.observed_claim: uses realistic long-horizon tasks and functional correctness of task completion across multiple web domains
external_primary_evidence.transfer_to_f2: prefer functional/end-state correctness and domain diversity over trajectory-text similarity

external_primary_evidence.source: tau-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
external_primary_evidence.observed_claim: compares final database state with annotated goal state and introduces pass^k to measure reliability over multiple trials
external_primary_evidence.transfer_to_f2: when stochastic/runtime candidates arrive, add repeated-execution reliability separately from mean success; do not mint reliability credit from one run

external_primary_evidence.source: tau^2-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
external_primary_evidence.observed_claim: programmatically generates diverse verifiable tasks from atomic components and uses ablations separating reasoning from communication/coordination errors
external_primary_evidence.transfer_to_f2: family/variant generation should be deterministic, provenance-bound and decomposable; failure attribution should remain typed rather than compressed into one score

external_primary_evidence.source: TUA-Bench: A Benchmark for General-Purpose Terminal-Use Agents
external_primary_evidence.observed_claim: contains 120 real-world tasks across five task families, deterministic setup scripts and execution-based scoring
external_primary_evidence.transfer_to_f2: general-purpose claims need breadth across explicit task families plus deterministic setup/evaluator lineage

external_primary_evidence.source: ConStat: Performance-Based Contamination Detection in Large Language Models
external_primary_evidence.observed_claim: defines suspicious contamination operationally as inflated performance that fails to generalize to rephrased samples, synthetic same-distribution samples or different benchmarks for the same task
external_primary_evidence.transfer_to_f2: use semantically equivalent variants and disjoint family/reference variants as anti-memorization controls; treat performance cliffs as benchmark-specificity evidence, not as proof of training-data contamination

external_primary_evidence.source: ReliabilityBench: Evaluating LLM Agent Reliability Under Production-Like Stress Conditions
external_primary_evidence.observed_claim: evaluates consistency, semantically equivalent perturbation robustness and controlled fault tolerance, with end-state-equivalent action metamorphic relations
external_primary_evidence.transfer_to_f2: metamorphic equivalence and controlled intervention are useful robustness dimensions, but WP807 should reuse WP805 recovery evidence rather than create a duplicate fault-injection subsystem

architecture_delta.reason: The current inner contract is useful and conservative, but a single shared holdout family is insufficient evidence for the word general. Rewriting the inner evaluator would duplicate working fail-closed logic and increase coordination risk.

minimal_new_object.name: GeneralizationBundleEvidence
minimal_new_object.purpose: bind one exact WP807 AgenticCoreReport digest to a deterministic task-family/variant/trial identity without exposing hidden evaluator state

minimal_outer_policy: freeze one candidate/SUT identity and all thresholds before reading target-family aggregate results
require at least two semantically disjoint task families before any cross-family generalization verdict; three or more is preferred when fixtures exist
within each family, preserve the current WP807 rule that the four capability measurements use a matched holdout identity
require independent receipt/reconciliation identities across family bundles; duplicate evidence cannot count twice
require one or more semantically equivalent metamorphic variants per selected family when such a deterministic variant can be defined without changing task truth
predeclare maximum allowed performance drop from base to equivalent variant; report the drop explicitly
report a capability/family matrix and conservative family floor instead of collapsing everything to a single AGI score

for deterministic repository components, repeated identical execution is reproducibility only; reliability credit requires distinct deterministic variants/fixtures or a later stochastic runtime candidate
reuse WP805 interruption/recovery evidence as PLANNING_EXECUTION robustness input; do not create a second fault/recovery authority
score evaluator-observed success/end-state and explicit efficiency counters only; narration/self-report remains non-evidence
keep all external benchmark, runtime, model, GRID10, GWT/J-Space, effect, completion and whole-system credits at zero

suggested_metamorphic_controls.constraint: rename public non-semantic labels through a sealed bijection while preserving action/observation semantics and evaluator truth
suggested_metamorphic_controls.falsifier: large score drop implies surface-token dependence or brittle grounding; it does not prove training contamination

suggested_metamorphic_controls.constraint: permute order of semantically unordered public observation fields only
only where an exact equivalence contract can be mechanically asserted; otherwise omit
suggested_metamorphic_controls.falsifier: large drop is robustness/generalization negative evidence, not world-truth evidence

suggested_metamorphic_controls.constraint: different generator/fixture-family identity with same declared capability contract and no target leakage
suggested_metamorphic_controls.falsifier: success only on the original family is benchmark-specificity evidence

bounded_verdicts: NOT_EVALUABLE when family/variant provenance is incomplete or current inner reports are not terminally evidence-bound
FALSIFIED_GENERALIZATION when any predeclared required family floor or metamorphic robustness bound fails
SUPPORTED_CROSS_FAMILY_AT_COMPONENT_SCOPE only when every required family/variant gate passes; this still grants zero external benchmark/runtime/model/whole-system credit

counterhypotheses_and_controls.counterhypothesis: A cross-family performance drop can reflect genuine difficulty mismatch rather than memorization or lack of general agency.
counterhypotheses_and_controls.control: separate within-family metamorphic deltas from across-family absolute score floors; report both and avoid causal attribution from score alone.

counterhypotheses_and_controls.counterhypothesis: A surface-renaming drop can punish legitimate interface grounding rather than expose benchmark memorization.
counterhypotheses_and_controls.control: only use bijective transformations declared semantically irrelevant by the interface contract; classify the result as robustness/brittleness evidence, not contamination proof.

counterhypotheses_and_controls.counterhypothesis: pass^k-style repeated execution adds no information to deterministic repository-only policies.
counterhypotheses_and_controls.control: do not repeat identical deterministic runs for reliability credit; use distinct deterministic variants/fixtures now, and reserve repeated stochastic trials for later model/runtime evidence.

counterhypotheses_and_controls.counterhypothesis: Adding another wrapper can create score bureaucracy without improving discrimination.
counterhypotheses_and_controls.control: accept the outer layer only if a concrete counterexample policy can pass the current single-family WP807 gate yet fail a disjoint-family or metamorphic gate. That executable discriminator is the promotion requirement.

promotion_gate.not_e5_reason: No F2 ablation has yet demonstrated a concrete benchmark-mimic policy that passes current WP807 while failing the proposed cross-family/metamorphic layer.
promotion_gate.next_high_information_test: After exact current WP807 upstream evidence is terminally reconciled, construct two deterministic policies under one sealed candidate identity: a general public-only policy and a deliberately surface-keyed benchmark-mimic policy. Show that both can satisfy the existing single-family inner gate while only the general policy survives a disjoint fixture family plus a semantics-preserving label-bijection variant. If the current WP807 gate already rejects the mimic, no successor layer is needed.
